scripts.quality: npm run quality:frontend && npm run quality:backend && npm run quality:secrets
scripts.quality:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff format --check app tests && uv run --directory backend ruff check app tests && uv run --directory backend mypy app tests && uv run --directory backend pytest
scripts.database:test: npx --no-install supabase db reset --local --no-seed && npx --no-install supabase migration list --local && npx --no-install supabase test db --local
scripts.database:lint: npx --no-install supabase db lint --local --schema private --fail-on warning
